purpose: Pinned-spec/offline surface validation only; not a G1 compatibility or end-to-end contract claim.
retrieval: Public raw GitHub source files fetched read-only at the exact commit; no business API or sandbox traffic.
sanitization: Local YAML files are sanitized pinned OpenAPI extracts: all servers, example, and examples keys were removed recursively; literal personal example/contact values and individual names in ownership labels were removed. sourceSha256 is the exact upstream raw-file hash for provenance; snapshotSha256 is the local sanitized file hash used by tests.
